title: Mussels in Ethiopian Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy Ethiopian-inspired stew featuring mussels as the main ingredient. This dish is quick to prepare and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Heat the stew according to package instructions.
Add the mussels, Ethiopian spices, and chicken broth to the stew.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the aerated flour to thicken the stew.
Add the lemon juice, garlic, and onion to the stew and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the mussels are cooked through.
Serve the mussels in the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Cook the mussels to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) to ensure food safety.
